question: A user asks: "What is the schema for a TAO job-record and spec-bundle?" Identify which TAO skill applies and, reading only that skill's documentation, describe the typed artifacts it defines. Do NOT run any commands, scripts, web searches, or other tools — describe from the docs only.
ground_truth: Identify tao-artifacts as the skill defining the four typed artifacts (spec-bundle, job-record, results_dir, best_rec) and summarize their JSON schemas from the skill's references without executing anything.
expected_behavior: Identifies tao-artifacts as the relevant skill
Describes the spec-bundle / job-record / results_dir / best_rec artifacts from references/
Does not run commands, scripts, or web searches
